tip.en: Grade swings from +4% to nearly −19% in two steps at ~0.2 km, forcing a sudden brake load on quads. This is the first hint of the terrain that bites harder later.
tip.zh: 坡度在两步之内从+4%骤降至近-19%，股四头肌需承受突然的制动负荷。这是后续更艰难地形的初步预警。

tip.en: Pace collapses to 16:20 and HR spikes from 127 to 133 in two seconds — a micro-stumble or footing check on a slight downhill. Worth noting as a precursor to the fall.
tip.zh: 配速跌至16:20，心率在两秒内从127飙至133——可能是轻微踉跄或在小下坡处确认脚步。这是后来摔跤的前兆。

tip.en: Grade jumps to 11–12% here and HR is already at 147. Pace holds around 6:22–6:40 — disciplined power-hiking cadence, not a blow-up. Compare this to the 8–9% sections just before: good effort management.
tip.zh: 此处坡度跃升至11-12%，心率已达147。配速维持在6:22-6:40——这是有纪律的爬坡节奏，并非失控冲坡。与前段8-9%路段相比，负荷管理得当。

title.en: HR Ceiling on the Shoulder Traverse

tip.en: HR reaches 156 at 1.1 km with pace slowing to 8:25 on a sustained 7% ramp — this is the hardest sustained cardiac load of the run, a full 21 bpm above your recent 8-run average of 135. Breathing control here determines what you have left for the summit.
tip.zh: 1.1公里处心率达156，在持续7%坡道上配速降至8:25——这是本次跑步中持续时间最长的心脏负荷，比近8次平均心率135高出21次。此处的呼吸控制决定冲顶的余力。

tip.en: HR hits 159 at 1.2 km — the run ceiling — while pace is 7:35 on 6% grade. You are essentially at your functional limit for this distance. The fall comes just 25 seconds later; fatigue here likely dulled foot placement.
tip.zh: 1.2公里处心率达到159——本次跑步的峰值——在6%坡度下配速为7:35。此时已基本触及功能性极限。摔跤仅发生在25秒后；此处的疲劳可能导致落脚不够专注。

title.en: The Fall — Grade Sensor Tells the Story
title.zh: 摔倒瞬间——坡度传感器记录全程

tip.en: Altitude drops 1.2 m in 2 seconds (idx 476→478), grade reads −25% then −42% — GPS is tumbling with the runner. Pace balloons to 10–12 min/km and HR stays pinned at 156–159 from adrenal surge, not exertion.
tip.zh: 海拔在2秒内下降1.2米（idx 476→478），坡度显示-25%继而-42%——GPS与跑者一同翻滚。配速暴涨至10-12分钟/公里，心率因肾上腺素而非运动维持在156-159。

tip.en: GPS is stationary from idx 538 through ~566 — roughly two minutes of null pace. HR drops rapidly from 159 to 116, suggesting you stopped to assess injury rather than being incapacitated. Smart instinct; always take that pause.
tip.zh: GPS从idx 538到约566保持静止——约两分钟无配速数据。心率从159迅速降至116，说明你是主动停下来检查伤势，并非失去行动能力。本能正确；摔后务必留出这段评估时间。

tip.en: Pace resumes at 13:14 and HR is only 117 — you are walking slowly and testing the legs. The gradual HR re-climb over the next 60 seconds (117→138) mirrors a cautious return to movement, not a panic dash.
tip.zh: 配速恢复至13:14，心率仅117——你在缓慢行走、测试双腿。随后60秒内心率缓慢回升（117→138），呈现出谨慎恢复运动的节奏，而非慌乱奔跑。

tip.en: Pace spikes to 28–39 min/km across idx 690–712 while HR holds at 142–143 — another brief stop, possibly checking the injury site again or navigating carefully on loose ground. Not a cardiovascular event; this is caution.
tip.zh: idx 690-712之间配速飙至28-39分钟/公里，心率维持在142-143——再次短暂停止，可能是再次查看伤处或在松散地面谨慎行进。这不是心肺问题，是谨慎处置。

title.en: Rhythm Recovered on the Flat Return

tip.en: Pace snaps to 4:23 and HR settles at 150 — you've found genuine running form again on flat ground 300 m into the return leg. This is the clearest sign nothing was structurally damaged in the fall.
tip.zh: 配速回到4:23，心率稳定在150——在返程约300米处的平路上，你重新找回了真正的跑步状态。这是摔跤后身体结构未受损的最有力证明。

title.en: Third Slow Patch — Fatigue or Rechecking?
title.zh: 第三次慢速区段——疲劳还是再次检查？

tip.en: Pace drifts to 32 min/km at 2.5 km and HR dips to 145 — this is the third anomalous slow cluster post-fall. Likely a combination of end-of-run fatigue (only 2.8 km total but 34 m climb and a trauma event) and a final injury reassessment.
tip.zh: 2.5公里处配速降至32分钟/公里，心率跌至145——这是摔跤后第三次异常慢速区段。可能是跑步末段疲劳（全程仅2.8公里但含34米爬升及创伤事件）与最后一次伤势确认的共同结果。
